items.title: Southampton baited over Spygate scandal in defeat at Watford
items.description: Southampton discovered that the Championship will be an unforgiving arena this season as they were baited about Spygate on their way to being beaten 2-1 by a new-look Watford side at Vicarage Road.

items.title: Danish Golf Championship: Winther pips fellow dane Højgaard in thrilling finish
items.description: Jeff Winther ended a four-year wait to claim his second DP World Tour title on Sunday at the Danish Golf Championship, pipping compatriot Rasmus Højgaard in a thrilling finish.
